name: SCRUM-9 - Login, Dashboard, and System Users Navigation
objective: Verify valid authentication, the Dashboard heading and widgets, Admin navigation, and System Users filters and controls.
precondition: OrangeHRM demo administrator credentials are configured in the environment.

steps.description: Log in using valid administrator credentials.
steps.expectedResult: The user is authenticated and the Dashboard is displayed.

steps.description: Verify the Dashboard heading and Time at Work, My Actions, and Quick Launch widgets.
steps.expectedResult: The Dashboard heading and expected widgets are visible.

steps.description: Open Admin and inspect the System Users screen.
steps.expectedResult: The System Users heading, filters, Search, Reset, and Add controls are available.
